correctness.rationale: A six-element associative idempotent band model proves exact free-band cardinality; identity 4x=2x reduces any polynomial to 4095 representatives, and the least congruence generated by all 4095 square identities is proved to have the universal free-algebra property. Explicit complete context saturation yields 4001 mergers, 94 classes, all semiring axioms checked on all 94^3 triples. Exactly 2 of the 8836 ordered pairs generate, and finite surjective endomorphisms are invertible. The complete standalone verifier ran with VERIFY_OK; finite exhaustive certification is exact because the reduction proves the universe is exhaustive.

value.rationale: The rank-two free object is a canonical minimal multigenerator invariant for the entire noncommutative semiring variety studied in 2026. Its exact order 94 is non-implied by and much smaller than the recent 4095 representative upper bound, while the commutative quotient has 39; full automorphism group C2 and exactly two generating pairs sharpen the structural picture. The precise invariant matters to future identity-testing and subvariety computations and is not an arbitrary parameter slice.
